guidance_fy26.src: Q3-26 earnings release (Ex. 99.1 to the Q3-26 Form 10-Q, filed 29-Oct-2026): FY26 outlook raised / narrowed
guidance_fy26.history: 25-Feb-2026 (FY25 release): adjusted EPS $4.50-4.80, net sales $2.55-2.65bn, capex $45-55m. 29-Apr-2026 (Q1-26): adjusted EPS $4.80-5.05, net sales $2.57-2.66bn. 30-Jul-2026 (Q2-26): adjusted EPS $5.12-5.30, net sales $2.58-2.67bn. 29-Oct-2026 (Q3-26): adjusted EPS $5.20-5.32 (raised), net sales $2.61-2.64bn (narrowed, 'primarily due to anticipated delays in deliveries of third-party refuse trucks'). Capex guidance $45-55m given in the FY25 release only (not repeated). All releases are exhibits to the 10-K / 10-Q filings on EDGAR (verified).

deals.new_way: Scranton Manufacturing Company LLC d/b/a New Way Trucks (refuse collection vehicles), ESG; closed 25-Nov-2025; purchase price $413.5m + $10.7m estimated earn-out (up to $54.0m over two years) = $424.2m; preliminary PPA: customer relationships $111.0m (15 years), trade names $50.5m (indefinite), goodwill $104.5m (tax-deductible). FY2025 contribution: net sales $21.2m, operating income $1.4m. 2024 revenue ~$249m and adjusted EBITDA ~$36m per the 25-Sep-2025 announcement deck (8-K Ex. 99.2, management estimates). Run-rate synergies $15-20m by end of 2028; EPS accretion $0.40-0.45 in 2028; neutral to EPS in 2026 (8-K 1-Dec-2025 Ex. 99.1).
deals.hog: Waterblasting LLC (Hog Technologies), ESG; closed 12-Feb-2025; $82.5m + $11.5m earn-out (raised to $15.0m, paid 1H26); FY2025 net sales $65.6m, operating income $9.5m (FY2025 10-K Note 2).
deals.kinloch: Kinloch Equipment & Supply (Texas distributor), ESG; closed 4-Dec-2025; $14.9m (FY2025 10-K Note 2).
deals.mega: Mega Equipment LLC (metal extraction support equipment), ESG; closed 16-Jan-2026; $45.0m; ~$40m 2024 net sales, ~30% aftermarket (8-K 18-Dec-2025 Ex. 99.1; Q3-26 10-Q Note 2).
deals.western_technology: Western Technology, Inc. (explosion-protected lighting), SSG; closed 1-Jul-2026; $9.2m (Q3-26 10-Q Note 2).
deals.gvs: Global Vacuum Systems, LLC (custom liquid vacuum trucks), ESG; closed 28-Oct-2026; initial price ~$29m incl. Texas facility; PPA not yet completed; revenue not disclosed (Q3-26 10-Q Note 14, subsequent event).

amort_sched.src: Q3-26 10-Q Note 6 (intangible assets): estimated aggregate amortization expense for intangibles held at 30-Sep-2026 (before GVS).

debt.at_2026_09_30: Total debt $421.5m (Note 5): 2025 Credit Agreement $419.3m = revolver $44.3m drawn + term loan $375.0m (delayed-draw $400m drawn 25-Nov-2025 for New Way; $25.0m voluntary prepayment in Q3-26), finance leases $2.2m; less unamortized issuance costs $1.2m. $1.1bn revolver + term loan mature 29-Oct-2030; RFR + 1.00-1.75%; commitment fee 0.10-0.25%; $1.04bn availability; no interest-rate swaps outstanding.

buyback: March 2020 program ($75m) and April 2025 program ($150m); $152.0m remaining at 26-Sep-2026 (Q3-26 10-Q Part II Item 2). 9M-2026 purchases of treasury stock $5.1m; FY2025 $39.7m.
dividend: Quarterly dividend $0.15 per share from Q1-26 (raised from $0.14); the Q3-26 release announces a similar $0.15 dividend payable in Q4-26.

price.note: Weighted average price paid per share for the 45,047 shares repurchased 30-Aug - 26-Sep-2026 ($113.9982; Q3-26 10-Q Part II Item 2, filed 29-Oct-2026) - the latest share price in an SEC filing. Form 4 open-market sales on 3/4-Aug-2026 were at $128.75-131.05. Update to market.
